title: Slack + n8n + AI - Event-Driven Integration
description: End-to-end integration combining Slack's Events API, n8n orchestration, and LangChain-powered AI agents. This architecture demonstrates how to build intelligent chat assistants for Slack using OpenAI models. You can also learn more about the underlying patterns and architecture in this post.

title: Webhooks Architecture in n8n
description: Webhooks are an essential part of modern integration strategies. In this post, we'll explore how to design and implement webhooks and how they are implemented in n8n.

title: OpenTelemetry Observability Stack
description: A visual diagram of an OpenTelemetry Observability Stack illustrating the flow of telemetry data from a backend application through an OpenTelemetry Collector, which processes and forwards logs to Loki and traces to Tempo.

title: Event Loop
description: An interactive guide to the NodeJS Event Loop, visualizing how it executes codes in order.
